title: Tech Note: Security via data encryption

historical_commentary.text: Data encryption remains a fundamental, still highly relevant concern for any networked application, but the specific cryptographic commands/algorithms available to 4D developers in 2003 have since been superseded by more modern, standards-based encryption support (e.g., TLS/SSL for transport security and stronger built-in encryption commands) in current 4D versions.
related_updates: Current 4D versions provide more modern built-in encryption and TLS/SSL transport security options than were available in 2003
